title: Install reuse enforcement layer across Symbio, WIP, and Pen
reason: Architecture and handoff are real; runtime execution requires Pen/Bridge receipt before claiming COMPLETE.

mandate.problem: Effort is leaking through duplicate builds: same capability, different names, rebuilt multiple times.
mandate.control: Every incoming code, idea, or draft must be intercepted before build or promotion and assessed against existing systems, processes, Commercial Widgets, and AGL flows.
mandate.standing_rule: Reuse-first is permanent control, not a one-off review.

plan_in_my_speak: Do not slow ideas down. Capture everything.
Do not block Symbio experimentation. Log, classify, and redirect early.
Do enforce at Pen. Nothing promotes without reuse classification and registry fit.
Net-new is allowed, but only after proof it cannot attach to an existing CW, worker, queue, evidence path, or Command Centre surface.
Duplicate capability does not coexist. It is merged, extended, archived, or killed through a gated refactor path.
Every decision emits evidence and updates the registry so we do not rediscover the same thing next week.

execution_steps.name: Bootstrap context
actions: Read global/GLOBAL_RULE.md
Read global/ENFORCEMENT_LIVE.md
Read global/CLAUDE_CONTAINER_CONSTRAINT.md
Read global/NO_MCP_GITHUB_CONNECTOR.md
Read docs/AGL_CONTROL_PLANE.md
Read global/ACTOR_BOOTSTRAP.md
execution_steps.acceptance: Worker confirms bridge-first, queue-first, receipt-first constraints before writes.

execution_steps.name: Create reuse schema
actions: Create ops.reuse_classification with PK, timestamps, object_key, match_type, matched_object_keys, confidence, rationale, source_layer, evidence_state.
Create ops.reuse_actions with PK, timestamps, object_key, action_type, target_object_key, status, owner, evidence_ref.
Create ops.duplication_blocks with PK, timestamps, object_key, equivalent_object_key, blocking_reason, severity, lifecycle_state.
Apply RLS and explicit service/worker policies.
Add indexes on object_key, target_object_key, match_type, status, created_at.
execution_steps.acceptance: Migration is idempotent and can be re-run without destructive changes.

execution_steps.name: Install classification worker
actions: Add classify_reuse worker.
Compare incoming object against ops.system_registry, Commercial Widget definitions, known workers, queues, evidence flows, CC surfaces, and prior reuse classifications.
Return FULL, PARTIAL, or NET_NEW with confidence and rationale.
Emit audit.evidence_register row for every classification.
execution_steps.acceptance: Given a sample incoming capability, worker writes ops.reuse_classification and evidence row.

execution_steps.name: Install fit mapper
actions: Map capability to existing AGL attach points: runtime queue, worker, evidence hook, closure register, CC widget/snippet, registry object.
Return integration plan before build begins.
If attach path exists, route to EXTEND not REBUILD.
execution_steps.acceptance: Any PARTIAL/FULL match includes concrete attach points or a recorded gap.

execution_steps.name: Install Pen duplication guard
actions: Block Pen promotion when FULL match exists and no merge/extend decision is closed.
Require NET_NEW proof when similarity is low but attach path is absent.
Write ops.duplication_blocks on hard block.
Allow GATED override only with evidence and rationale.
execution_steps.acceptance: Promotion fails closed when reuse classification is missing or duplicate unresolved.

execution_steps.name: Install refactor trigger
actions: Create runtime.work_queue merge/refactor jobs for overlap.
Attach affected object keys and target canonical object key.
Mark duplicate object lifecycle as blocked or archived only after evidence.
execution_steps.acceptance: Overlap produces a merge/refactor job, not another standalone build.

execution_steps.name: Install registry updater
actions: Update ops.system_registry for canonical naming, lifecycle, owner, and evidence_status.
Update Commercial Widget definitions when capability maps to a CW.
Reject closure if registry and CW definitions are stale.
execution_steps.acceptance: No COMPLETE state without registry update and evidence binding.

execution_steps.name: Install continuous sweeps
actions: Schedule duplication_sweep hourly.
Schedule cw_overlap_scan daily.
Schedule orphan_capability_scan daily.
Run naming_drift_check per deploy.
execution_steps.acceptance: Sweeps emit evidence, gaps, and queue jobs without blocking ideation.

execution_steps.name: Validate speed and innovation safeguards
actions: Confirm WIP remains unrestricted capture.
Confirm Symbio remains build-friendly with log/redirect, not hard stop.
Confirm Pen is the hard enforcement boundary.
Confirm NET_NEW fast lane exists with proof bundle.
Confirm false-block rollback path exists.
execution_steps.acceptance: System proves reuse enforcement does not block ideation or dev experimentation.

execution_steps.name: Emit final receipts
actions: Write receipts/runtime/reuse-enforcement-layer-2026-04-27.initial.receipt.json when accepted.
Write receipts/runtime/reuse-enforcement-layer-2026-04-27.execution.receipt.json after runtime validation.
Update audit.reality_ledger from PARTIAL to REAL only after runtime proof.
execution_steps.acceptance: Completion requires GitHub receipt plus Supabase/evidence proof.

agent_roles.action: Scan new code/ideas vs registry and Commercial Widgets
Map capability into existing AGL flows: queue, worker, evidence, CC
Block promotion if equivalent capability exists
Raise merge/refactor jobs where overlap exists
agent_roles.outcome: Duplicates collapsed into one canonical unit

agent_roles.action: Enforce ops.system_registry and Commercial Widget updates

decision_rules: No build proceeds without reuse check record.
Net-new requires proof it cannot attach to existing CW or AGL flow.
Duplicate capability equals merge, extend, archive, or kill; never silent coexistence.
Canonical naming comes from registry only.
Only Pen hard-blocks; WIP and Symbio preserve idea/build speed.
success_metrics: New builds with reuse classification reaches 100%.
Promotion blocks with missing classification reaches 100%.
Time-to-value decreases by extending existing flows instead of rebuilding.

failure_handling.rollback: GATED override with evidence and rationale
failure_handling.next: Tune threshold and update training examples

failure_handling.rollback: Lock affected object and force registry sync
Mark PRETEND and re-run idempotent job

done_definition: Schema/worker/gate/sweep changes are applied or queued with runtime proof.
Reality ledger says REAL, not PARTIAL or PRETEND.
No manual loop remains except explicit GATED override for risky promotion decisions.
